title: Common-word curation list for the surname Bloom filter
description: Ordinary English words that the multilingual surname Bloom filter may also contain as genuine inventory rows. The Swift NameGazetteer reads this sidecar on top of the filter: a surname candidate that is an exact (NFKC-lowercased) member receives no surname credit and no fuzzy fallback, and the first tagger pass does not count its membership as inventory support. The Bloom filters are never edited by this artifact (demote, never strip). Source: the in-estate `BloomFilterFPRTests.nonNames` list (549 authored entries, 546 unique); no external frequency table. This is a standalone sidecar -- not part of the signed Bloom manifest.
